meta.name: add-resend
meta.description: Add Resend (email) channel integration via Chat SDK.

copy.tagline: 集成 Resend 邮件发送通道到聊天应用
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要在聊天应用中添加邮件发送能力
copy.tagline_en: Integrate Resend email channel into your chat app
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to add email sending to a chat application

howto.what: 装上后,Claude 会把 NanoClaw 接入 Resend 邮箱服务:复制并注册邮件适配器、安装依赖、自动构建验证;再引导你完成 Resend 账号、域名、密钥和 webhook 配置,把凭据存入 .env,最后把你设为所有者并发送一封欢迎邮件,让你能通过邮件和代理对话。
howto.when: 当你要求给 NanoClaw 接入 Resend 邮箱、添加 email 渠道,或说要通过邮件和代理对话时,Claude 会执行这个技能的步骤。

say.text: 帮我把 NanoClaw 接入 Resend 邮箱。
say.note: 会开始复制适配器、安装依赖并引导你配置 Resend。

say.text: 添加 Resend 邮件渠道。
say.note: 会执行添加渠道的步骤,包括构建验证。

say.text: 配置 Resend 并给我发一封欢迎邮件。
say.note: 会提示你填写密钥和地址,然后发送 hello 邮件。

howto.what_en: Claude wires NanoClaw to Resend email: copies/registers adapter, installs pinned dependency, builds and validates. Then it prompts for your credentials, saves them in .env, registers you as owner, and emails a hello.
howto.when_en: When you ask to add a Resend email channel to NanoClaw, or to connect it to email for async conversations, Claude runs this skill.

say_en.text: Wire NanoClaw up to Resend email.
say_en.note: Starts copying adapter, installing deps, guiding setup.
Runs the apply steps: copy, register, install, build, validate

say_en.text: Set up Resend and send me a hello email.
say_en.note: Prompts for credentials, saves, registers, emails hello.
